name: Content Delivery Declaration
description: Declares how coded presentation obtains published structured content.
purpose: Makes content integration explicit without coupling NEXT F contracts to a hosting provider.

options.label: Runtime API
options.description: Published content is resolved by trusted/public content APIs during request/runtime execution.

options.label: Build Time
options.description: Published content is materialized during a build or regeneration process.

options.label: Hybrid
options.description: The implementation combines build-time and runtime delivery under explicit component/data rules.

fields.description: Whether public delivery is restricted to published/public-eligible content.
Whether the implementation supports a protected preview flow for unpublished revisions.

validationRules.description: Public visitor delivery must not expose Draft, private or Admin-only data.
Preview support must use authenticated or otherwise protected preview authorization and cannot make drafts publicly enumerable.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
